scope: First held-out inference attempt for the H3 topology r2 epoch-0 checkpoint
summary: The first epoch-0 evaluation stopped at the GPU safety preflight because the requested physical GPU had less free memory than the declared minimum; no generation was attempted.
evidence: The copied rank-16 checkpoint has SHA-256 f022c783de9b4d76c9ecfa8d3384cba89a32e67c49d44d5b73a9e0bf89b8bac0.
GPU 1 had 43751 MiB free while the command required at least 70000 MiB.
The manifest records status failed, honest_status BLOCKED, and a PreflightError before model loading or generation.
All action variants remained pending and no output video was emitted.
lessons: A checkpoint evaluation must select a currently suitable physical GPU rather than assuming the previously free device remains available.
Fail-closed GPU preflight prevents an unsafe partial load from being mistaken for a model-quality failure.
limitations: This attempt contains no candidate-quality evidence.
next_actions: Retry in a new experiment directory on a physical GPU that passes the measured free-memory threshold.
